applied.summary: Boundless Recreation, an RV manufacturer founded in 2025, began production in October 2026 at a 104,000-square-foot facility at 705 Maple St. in Bristol, where it makes fifth wheels and plans to add travel trailers.

Autocam Medical, a medical device contract manufacturer, opened a 100,000-square-foot, $70 million plant along US 30 in the Warsaw Technology Park, where it makes orthopedic and spinal implants, precision instruments and orthopedic cutting tools.
